code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full-height and full-width divider lines partition the grid into
    # equal cells; repeat each tile periodically across the grid.
    vr = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
    vc = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    th, tw = vr, vc
    return [[grid[r % th][c % tw] if (r % th < th and c % tw < tw) else 0
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
